To determine the GDP per capita of Sweden in 2015, you would use a SQL SELECT statement on your table containing economic data.

Here's an example query:

```sql
SELECT GDP_per_capita AS gdp_sweden_2015 FROM world_fact WHERE country_name = 'Sweden' AND year = 2015;
```

This query selects the GDP per capita value for Sweden specifically in the year 2015 from your `world_fact` table.

If you want to retrieve more details, here's another version:

```sql
SELECT GDP_per_capita, country_name, year FROM world_fact WHERE country_name = 'Sweden' AND year = 2015;
```

This query will return all the relevant fields for Sweden in 2015. Note that you might want to round the GDP per capita value for better readability:

```sql
SELECT ROUND(GDP_per_capita, 2) AS gdp_sweden_2015 FROM world_fact WHERE country_name = 'Sweden' AND year = 2015;
```

This will display the GDP per capita rounded to two decimal places.
